# setup whose stop of the job is refused: another_installation when the commit asks
# each launchctl call, then the state of the files as it was asked
print gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=absent own=present
print gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=absent own=present
print gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=present own=present
print gui/UID/com.agent-archive.collector  |  journal=present own=present
# exit 1, end: journal=absent own=present
